evidence: Workbook row 53 and its internal annotation require product-specific authorship and comparison with sibling concepts; neither adds a separate quantitative originality threshold. The frozen brief is explicitly a compensation change desk: fully committed requisitions must exchange hires through one affordable net transaction (task/instruction.md:1), with stale-preview rejection and original-receipt retry after later changes (line 3). Its arena_slice is recruiting-hiring-operations and provenance acknowledges adaptation of the supplied HireOps product (task/task.toml:14-15). This matches the available suite guidance to reuse infrastructure while authoring distinct domain behavior (NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:203). Closest sibling Pellmoor is also hiring-related and uses batches, revisions and durable retries, but its public substance is ordered candidate stages, complete panel assessments and vacancy opening counts (projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline/environment/instructions/hiring-rules.md:3-9,27-66). Its batches take applicants from one vacancy from interview to offer and preserve identifier order as intent (lines 69-113). HireOps instead transfers 2-4 already committed offers across requisitions, makes reordered members the same intent, nets releasing/replacement monetary commitments, preserves grants/referrals and original vesting anchors, and detects intervening economic history even when balances return (frozen hireops_rules.md:423-478). Those are different state transitions, formulas, permissions and failure conditions, not renamed entities. ExpenseFlow shares integer accounting, tiers and an append-only ledger, but grades dated FX, capped reimbursement, VAT reclaim, cost-center allocation and receipt clawback (its instruction.md:5-7 and functional/judge.toml:68-95); HireOps grades intrinsic equity, annualization, separate run-rate/band-basis formulas, signing/equity vesting and referral clocks (frozen functional/judge.toml:95-139,609-652). Task-specific criteria correspond to the distinctive change desk: netted full-budget cycles (line 938), cross-requisition lineage (956), signed bonus differences (965), replacement equity (983), retained referral provenance (992), history-sensitive freshness (1055), and post-transfer original-start vesting (1181,1190). The frozen template only supplies a placeholder functional criterion and generic persistence contract, not these product rules. Source implements these authored mechanics in solution/app/src/change-sets.js:38-64 and 94-140. Concrete broken alternative: a renamed batch-capacity/ordinary sequential revision engine can look like HireOps yet refuses a fully funded swap because neither destination has headroom first. The current hro_change_net_budget criterion expressly requires this swap. The indexed sequential_budget raw witness records HTTP 409 versus expected 200 at batch-domain.cjs:40; I independently reproduced its mutation from the frozen source and obtained SHA256 827d9c9edb1b5983a6da10be5065a276fa7669193b723f7dfe0cdce9a6f596bd, matching its recorded module. Thus the generic sibling behavior is observably insufficient under this authored task. Concrete conforming alternative: omit all optional operational demonstration rows while preserving required accounts/constants and implement the authored operations. instruction.md:11 expressly permits this; app_context tells the judge to create its own controls. The indexed empty_operational_seed witness removes precisely those optional rows (batch-witnesses.cjs:13-16) and reports 15/15 finite HTTP observation groups, including netted exchange and durable replay. The four source-module hashes in that record match frozen source. It is not rejected merely for lacking the golden history. Evidence integrity: all 445 current indexed artifact hashes matched on this review; index SHA256 f1266aafb735e7f790c355938710c6432a48a2f2a00af69966438cee77c128ab. Cited raw result SHA256 values are 6c4dc4035574baba26a9011e6c51aae34ed97136d84b1ebe7b1e6684fdbbfdd4 (sequential_budget) and a44c0bf81b27981d9bf1d63239f8b7ce7da5733d6d70aef425e2350a76b7732f (empty_operational_seed). These are finite product observations, not configured judge or model scores. Row 53 is established by the actual source/sibling comparison; this verdict does not clear missing configured workload, reward or hosted evidence assigned to other rows.
